# BI data model and field definitions (auto-generated)

_Generated by `python scripts/build_bi_docs.py` from the actual tables. All data are **SYNTHETIC**._

**Where the tables live.** BigQuery mode: dbt builds `<dataset>_reporting` (`rpt_*`); Python publishes `<dataset>_analytics` (`bi_*`). Local mode: DuckDB schemas `gp_reporting` / `gp_bi`, and identical CSVs in `dashboard/bi_exports/`.

**Looker Studio rules of thumb.** Metrics are SUMs. Build ratios as calculated fields `SUM(a)/SUM(b)` (never average a ratio). Use `*_eligible_*` columns for ROAS / LTV / CAC-by-cohort so recent cohorts do not distort results.
